```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(car)
library(here)
library(lme4)
library(knitr)
library(arrow)
library(DHARMa)
library(emmeans)
library(tidyverse)

source(here('scripts/functions/diagnostic_fcns.r'))
source(here('scripts/functions/functions_analysis.r'))

models <- read_rds(here('output/model_object.rds'))$models
boots <- read_rds(here('output/model_object.rds'))$boots
drops <- read_rds(here('output/model_object.rds'))$drops
stab <- read_rds(here('output/model_object.rds'))$stab

df_testreach <- read_parquet(here('data/prereg.parquet')) |> 
  filter(action == 'test_reach_all') |> 
  filter(!is.na(pls)) |> 
  mutate(condition_hand = as.numeric(condition=='hand') - mean(as.numeric(condition=='hand')), #dummy code and center 
         condition_agent = as.numeric(condition == 'agent') - mean(as.numeric(condition == 'agent')),
         species_bonobo = as.numeric(species == 'bonobo') - mean(as.numeric(species == 'bonobo')),
         species_orang = as.numeric(species == 'orang') - mean(as.numeric(species == 'orang')),
         z_trial_consecutive = (trial_consecutive - mean(trial_consecutive, na.rm = T))/sd(trial_consecutive, na.rm = T))


df_hab <- read_parquet(here('data/prereg_latency.parquet')) |> 
  filter(action == 'hab1') |> 
  filter(!is.na(latency_filtered)) |> 
  mutate(condition_hand = as.numeric(condition=='hand') - mean(as.numeric(condition=='hand')), #dummy code and center 
         condition_agent = as.numeric(condition == 'agent') - mean(as.numeric(condition == 'agent')),
         species_bonobo = as.numeric(species == 'bonobo') - mean(as.numeric(species == 'bonobo')),
         species_orang = as.numeric(species == 'orang') - mean(as.numeric(species == 'orang')),
         z_trial_consecutive = (trial_consecutive - mean(trial_consecutive, na.rm = T))/sd(trial_consecutive, na.rm = T))

df_expl_subset <- read_parquet(here('data/expl.parquet')) |> 
  filter(action == 'test_reach_all') |> 
  filter(!is.na(pls_transform)) |> 
  mutate(cond_center = as.numeric(condition == levels(condition)[2]) - mean(as.numeric(condition == levels(condition)[2])),
         species_bonobo = as.numeric(species == 'bonobo') - mean(as.numeric(species == 'bonobo')),
         species_orang = as.numeric(species == 'orang') - mean(as.numeric(species == 'orang')),
         z_trial_within = (trial_within - mean(trial_within, na.rm = T))/sd(trial_within, na.rm = T))



knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = F, message = F, include = F)
options(knitr.kable.NA = '')
```

## Proportional looking score
```{r pls, include = T}
vif(lm(pls_transform ~ condition + species + z_trial_consecutive + handseen + agentseen, data = df_testreach))
```
Overdispersion was not an issue (dispersion parameter = `r round(testDispersion(models[["pls_noint"]])$statistic, 2)`).


Proportional looking score: The condition x species interaction was removed as it did not significantly improve model fit (χ² = `r rnd(drops[["pls"]][['LRT']][5])`, df = `r drops[["pls"]][['Df']][5]`, `r p(drops[["pls"]][4][[1]][5])`). In the reduced model, likelihood ratio tests showed that none of the fixed effects were statistically significant (all p \> `r round(min(drops[["pls_noint"]][4], na.rm = T),2)`).

## Total viewing time
```{r view-time, include = T}
vt_pairwise_condition <- as.data.frame(emmeans(models[['vt_noint']], pairwise ~ condition, ref = 'mech', adjust = NULL)$contrasts)

vt_pairwise_species <- as.data.frame(emmeans(models[['vt_noint']], pairwise ~ species, adjust = NULL)$contrasts)

vif(lm(either_time ~ condition + species + z_trial_consecutive + handseen + agentseen, data = df_testreach))
```

Overdispersion was not an issue (dispersion parameter = `r round(testDispersion(models[["vt_noint"]])$statistic, 2)`).

Total looking time to objects: The condition x species interaction was removed as it did not significantly improve model fit (χ² = `r rnd(drops[['vt']][['LRT']][5])`, df = `r (drops[['vt']][['Df']][5])`, `r p(drops[['vt']][['Pr(>Chi)']][5])`). In the reduced model, condition significantly affected looking time (χ² = `r rnd(drops[['vt_noint']][[3]][2])`, df = `r drops[['vt_noint']]$Df[2]`, `r p(drops[['vt_noint']][[4]][2])`). Participants looked significantly less in the hand compared to the mechanical claw condition (estimate `r rnd(-vt_pairwise_condition$estimate[1])` ±`r rnd(vt_pairwise_condition$SE[1])`, z = `r rnd(-vt_pairwise_condition$z.ratio[1])`, `r p(vt_pairwise_condition$p.value[1])`), and compared to the agentive claw condition (estimate `r rnd(vt_pairwise_condition$estimate[3])` ±`r rnd(vt_pairwise_condition$SE[3])`, z = `r rnd(vt_pairwise_condition$z.ratio[3])`, `r p(vt_pairwise_condition$p.value[3])`). There were no significant differences in looking time between the agentive and mechanical claw conditions (z = `r rnd(-vt_pairwise_condition$z.ratio[2])`, `r p(vt_pairwise_condition$p.value[2])`). There was also a marginal effect of species in the model (χ² = `r rnd(drops[['vt_noint']][[3]][3])`, df = `r drops[['vt_noint']][['Df']][3]`, `r p(drops[['vt_noint']][[4]][3])`). Orangutans looked significantly more compared to chimpanzees (estimate `r rnd(-vt_pairwise_species$estimate[2])` ±`r rnd(vt_pairwise_species$SE[2])`, z = `r rnd(-vt_pairwise_species$z.ratio[2])`, `r p(vt_pairwise_species$p.value[2])`) and bonobos (estimate `r rnd(-vt_pairwise_species$estimate[3])` ±`r rnd(vt_pairwise_species$SE[3])`, z = `r rnd(-vt_pairwise_species$z.ratio[3])`, `r p(vt_pairwise_species$p.value[3])`), while there were no significant differences in looking time between chimpanzees and bonobos (z = `r rnd(-vt_pairwise_species$z.ratio[1])`, `r p(vt_pairwise_species$p.value[1])`).

## First look
```{r first-look, include = T}

vif(lm(target_firsthit ~ condition + species + z_trial_consecutive + handseen + agentseen, data = df_testreach))

fl_pairwise_plt <- as.data.frame(emmeans(models[['fl_noint']],  ~ condition, ref = 'mech', type = 'response'))
```

Overdispersion was not an issue (dispersion parameter = `r round(testDispersion(models[["fl_noint"]])$statistic, 2)`).

First looks: The condition x species interaction was removed as it did not significantly improve model fit (χ² = `r rnd(drops[['fl']][['LRT']][5])`, df = `r (drops[['fl']][['Df']][5])`, `r p(drops[['fl']][[4]][5])`). In the reduced model, likelihood ratio tests showed that none of the fixed effects were statistically significant (all p \> `r p(min(drops[["fl_noint"]][4], na.rm = T))`).


## Saccades
```{r saccades, include = T}
summ_sc_model_noint <- summary(models[['sc_noint']])$coefficients$cond

sc_pairwise_condition <- as.data.frame(emmeans(models[['sc_noint']], pairwise ~ condition, ref = 'mech', adjust=NULL)$contrasts)

simulateResiduals(fittedModel = models[['sc']], plot = T)

vif(lm(latency_filtered ~ condition + species + z_trial_consecutive + handseen + agentseen, data = df_hab))

diagnostics.plot(models[['sc']])
```

Overdispersion was not an issue (dispersion parameter = `r round(testDispersion(models[["sc_noint"]])$statistic, 2)`).

Saccadic latency: The condition x species interaction was removed as it did not significantly improve model fit (χ² = `r rnd(drops[['sc']][['LRT']][5])`, df = `r drops[['sc']]$Df[5]`, `r p(drops[['sc']][[4]][5])`). In the reduced model, condition significantly affected looking time (χ² = `r rnd(drops[['sc_noint']][[3]][2])`, df = `r drops[['sc_noint']]$Df[2]`, `r p(drops[['sc_noint']][[4]][2])`), with longer latency in the hand compared to the agent condition (estimate `r rnd(sc_pairwise_condition$estimate[3])` ±`r rnd(sc_pairwise_condition$SE[3])`, z = `r rnd(sc_pairwise_condition$z.ratio[3])`, `r p(sc_pairwise_condition$p.value[3])`) and compared to the mechanical claw condition (estimate `r rnd(-sc_pairwise_condition$estimate[1])` ±`r rnd(sc_pairwise_condition$SE[1])`, z = `r rnd(-sc_pairwise_condition$z.ratio[1])`, `r p(sc_pairwise_condition$p.value[1])`). There were no significant differences between the mechanical and agentive claw conditions (z = `r rnd(-sc_pairwise_condition$z.ratio[2])`, `r p(sc_pairwise_condition$p.value[2])`). There was also a marginal effect of trial number (χ² = `r rnd(drops[['sc_noint']][[3]][4])`, df = `r drops[['sc_noint']]$Df[4]`, `r p(drops[['sc_noint']][[4]][4])`), with latencies decreasing across trials (estimate `r rnd(summ_sc_model_noint[6])` `r p(summ_sc_model_noint[30])`).

## Exploratory proportional looking score
```{r expl-pls, include = T}
summ_model_pls_noint_expl <- as_tibble(summary(models[['expl_pls_noint']])$coefficients$cond, rownames = 't')
vif(lm(pls_transform ~ condition + exp + species + z_trial_within, data = df_expl_subset))
```

(dispersion parameter = `r round(testDispersion(models[['expl_pls_noint']])$statistic, 2)`)

The condition x year x species interaction term was not statistically significant (χ² = `r rnd(drops[['expl_pls']]$LRT[3])`, df = `r drops[['expl_pls']]$Df[3]`, `r p(drops[['expl_pls']][[4]][3])`), and neither was the condition x year interaction term (χ² = `r rnd(drops[['expl_pls_1int']]$LRT[4])`, df = `r drops[['expl_pls_1int']]$Df[4]`, `r p(drops[['expl_pls_1int']][[4]][4])`), so they were removed from the model. In the reduced model, there was a significant effect of condition (χ² = `r rnd(drops[['expl_pls_noint']]$LRT[2])`, df = `r drops[['expl_pls_noint']]$Df[2]`, `r p(drops[['expl_pls_noint']][[4]][2])`) and a marginal effect of experiment year (χ² = `r rnd(drops[['expl_pls_noint']]$LRT[3])`, df = `r drops[['expl_pls_noint']]$Df[3]`, `r p(drops[['expl_pls_noint']][[4]][3])`). Great apes looked at the goal object more in the hand compared to the mechanical claw condition (estimate = `r rnd(summ_model_pls_noint_expl$Estimate[2])` ±`r rnd(summ_model_pls_noint_expl[[3]][2])`, z = `r rnd(summ_model_pls_noint_expl[[4]][2])`, `r p(summ_model_pls_noint_expl[[5]][2])`). They also looked marginally less at the goal object in 2024 compared to 2014 (estimate = `r rnd(summ_model_pls_noint_expl$Estimate[3])` ±`r rnd(summ_model_pls_noint_expl[[3]][3])`, z = `r rnd(summ_model_pls_noint_expl[[4]][3])`, `r p(summ_model_pls_noint_expl[[5]][3])`).

## Exploratory viewing time
```{r expl-vt, include = T}
vt_pairwise_species_expl <- as.data.frame(emmeans(models[['expl_vt_1int']], pairwise ~ species)$contrasts)

vt_pairwise_exp <- as_data_frame(pairs(emmeans(models[['expl_vt_1int']], ~condition*exp), by = 'exp'))

vif(lm(either_time ~ condition * exp + species + z_trial_within, data = df_expl_subset))

```

(dispersion parameter = `r round(testDispersion(models[['expl_vt_1int']])$statistic, 2)`)


The condition x year x species interaction term was removed as it was not statistically significant (χ² = `r rnd(drops[['expl_vt']]$LRT[3])`, df = `r drops[['expl_vt']]$Df[3]`, `r p(drops[['expl_vt']][[4]][3])`). There was a significant interaction effect between condition and experiment year (χ² = `r rnd(drops[['expl_vt_1int']]$LRT[4])`, df = `r drops[['expl_vt_1int']]$Df[4]`, `r p(drops[['expl_vt_1int']][[4]][4])`). In 2024, the apes looked marginally more at the objects during the mechanical claw condition (estimate = `r rnd(vt_pairwise_exp$estimate[2])` ±`r rnd(vt_pairwise_exp$SE[2])`, z = `r rnd(vt_pairwise_exp$z.ratio[2])`, `r p(vt_pairwise_exp$p.value[2])`), while in 2014 there were no significant differences between conditions in looking time at the objects (z = `r rnd(-vt_pairwise_exp$z.ratio[1])`, `r p(vt_pairwise_exp$p.value[1])`). There was also a significant main effect of species (χ² = `r rnd(drops[['expl_vt_1int']]$LRT[2])`, df = `r drops[['expl_vt_1int']]$Df[2]`, `r p(drops[['expl_vt_1int']][[4]][2])`). This was driven by higher looking times in orangutans - they looked at the objects more compared to chimpanzees (estimate = `r rnd(-vt_pairwise_species_expl$estimate[2])` ±`r rnd(vt_pairwise_species_expl$SE[2])`, z = `r rnd(-vt_pairwise_species_expl$z.ratio[2])`, `r p(vt_pairwise_species_expl$p.value[2])`) as well as bonobos (estimate = `r rnd(-vt_pairwise_species_expl$estimate[3])` ±`r rnd(vt_pairwise_species_expl$SE[3])`, z = `r rnd(-vt_pairwise_species_expl$z.ratio[3])`, `r p(vt_pairwise_species_expl$p.value[3])`). There were no significant differences between the looking times of chimpanzees and bonobos (z = `r rnd(-vt_pairwise_species_expl$z.ratio[1])`, `r p(vt_pairwise_species_expl$p.value[1])`).





## Exploratory first look
```{r expl-fl, include = T}
summ_fl_noint_expl <- as_tibble(summary(models[['expl_fl_noint']])$coefficients$cond, rownames = 't')
fl_expl_plt <- emmeans(models[['expl_fl_noint']], ~ condition | exp, type = "response")


vif(lm(target_firsthit ~ condition + exp + species + z_trial_within, data = df_expl_subset))
```

(dispersion parameter = `r round(testDispersion(models[['expl_fl_noint']])$statistic, 2)`)

First looks: The condition x year x species interaction term was not statistically significant (χ² = `r rnd(drops[['expl_fl']]$LRT[3])`, df = `r drops[['expl_fl']]$Df[3]`, `r p(drops[['expl_fl']][[4]][3])`), and neither was the condition x year interaction term (χ² = `r rnd(drops[['expl_fl_1int']]$LRT[4])`, df = `r drops[['expl_fl_1int']]$Df[4]`, `r p(drops[['expl_fl_1int']][[4]][4])`), so they were removed from the model. In the reduced model, there was a significant effect of condition (χ² = `r rnd(drops[['expl_fl_noint']]$LRT[2])`, df = `r drops[['expl_fl_noint']]$Df[2]`, `r p(drops[['expl_fl_noint']][[4]][2])`). Great apes made more first looks at the goal object more in the hand compared to the mechanical claw condition (estimate = `r rnd(summ_fl_noint_expl$Estimate[2])` ±`r rnd(summ_fl_noint_expl[[3]][2])`, z = `r rnd(summ_fl_noint_expl[[4]][2])`, `r p(summ_fl_noint_expl[[5]][2])`).

## Supplementary tables
```{r model-tables, include=T}
tables <- list()

for (n in c('pls', 'vt', 'fl', 'sc', 'expl_pls', 'expl_vt', 'expl_fl')){
  t_coef <- as_tibble(coef(summary(models[[n]]))$cond, rownames = 'row') |> 
    rename(SE = `Std. Error`, z = `z value`)
  
  t_ci <- as_tibble(boots[[n]]$ci.estimates$fe, rownames = 'row2') |>
    left_join(as_tibble(stab[[n]]$summary)) |>
    filter(str_detect(row2, 'cond@')) %>%
    mutate(row = str_replace(row2, 'cond@', ''))
  
  tables[[n]] <- t_coef |> #remove z
    left_join(t_ci) |> 
    mutate(row = str_replace_all(row, '\\(|\\)', '')) |> 
    select(term = row, Estimate, SE, `lower CI` = X2.5., `upper CI` = X97.5., `stability min` = min, `stability max` = max) |> 
    format_table() 
}

kable(tables[['pls']], align = 'lcccccc', caption = 'Proportional looking score full')
kable(tables[['vt']], align = 'lcccccc', caption = 'Viewing time full')
kable(tables[['fl']], align = 'lcccccc', caption = 'First looks full')
kable(tables[['sc']], align = 'lcccccc', caption = 'Saccades full')
kable(tables[['expl_pls']], align = 'lcccccc', caption = 'Exploratory - proportional looking score full')
kable(tables[['expl_vt']], align = 'lcccccc', caption = 'Exploratory - viewing time full')
kable(tables[['expl_fl']], align = 'lcccccc', caption = 'Exploratory - first looks full')


for (n in c('pls_noint', 'vt_noint', 'fl_noint', 'sc_noint')){
  t_coef <- as_tibble(coef(summary(models[[n]]))$cond, rownames = 'row') |> 
    rename(SE = `Std. Error`, z = `z value`)
  
  t_drops <- as_tibble(drops[[n]], rownames = 'row_drop') |>
    mutate(row = c('(Intercept)', 'conditionhand', 'speciesbonobo', 'z_trial_consecutive', 'handseen', 'agentseen'))
  
  t_ci <- as_tibble(boots[[n]]$ci.estimates$fe, rownames = 'row2') |>
    filter(str_detect(row2, 'cond@')) %>%
    mutate(row = str_replace(row2, 'cond@', ''))
  
  tables[[n]] <- t_coef |> 
    left_join(t_ci) |> 
    left_join(t_drops) |>
    mutate(row = str_replace_all(row, '\\(|\\)', '')) |> 
    select(term = row, Estimate, SE, `lower CI` = X2.5., `upper CI` = X97.5., `χ²` = LRT, Df, p = `Pr(>Chi)`) |> 
    format_table(p = T) 
}
kable(tables[['pls_noint']], align = 'lccccccccc', caption = 'Proportional looking score reduced')
kable(tables[['vt_noint']], align = 'lccccccccc', caption = 'Viewing time reduced')
kable(tables[['fl_noint']], align = 'lccccccccc', caption = 'First looks reduced')
kable(tables[['sc_noint']], align = 'lccccccccc', caption = 'Saccades reduced')



for (n in c('expl_pls_noint', 'expl_fl_noint')){
  t_coef <- as_tibble(coef(summary(models[[n]]))$cond, rownames = 'row') |>
  rename(SE = `Std. Error`, z = `z value`)

t_drops <- as_tibble(drops[[n]], rownames = 'row_drop') |>

t_ci <- as_tibble(boots[[n]]$ci.estimates$fe, rownames = 'row2') |>

tables[[n]] <- t_coef |>
```
